hypothesis: Historical H3-PACK hypothesis: more widely separated predictions might reduce redundant kernel coverage. Impact on hidden truth and the leaderboard was not measured.
mechanism: The prior campaign measured a geometric packing proxy; overlap of geometric kernels is not the same as measured true-positive credit and does not establish an improvement on organizer truth.
named_non_fault_process_that_could_mimic: Lithologic boundaries, survey artifacts and non-fault geological contacts may still receive predictions; a geometry-only design is not immune to false positives.

validator.status: Local diagnostic against unauthenticated owner mirror; not organizer acceptance.

projection.assumption: regression fitted on the eight dotted focus rasters (score = a + b*D/1000 + c*collar); the packing multiplier assumes the kmass/dot gain transfers fully (or half) into TP. This is a PROJECTION, not a score.
projection.headline: UNVALIDATED HISTORICAL PROJECTION; not a measured or predicted leaderboard score.
projection.caution: Dot count and packing efficiency are 98% collinear across the registry (r=-0.980), so the registry cannot separate the two mechanisms. The base case uses the regression alone, which already absorbs whatever packing effect exists inside the fitted range.
projection.status: Exploratory geometry extrapolation, not actionable and not evidence of improvement.

verdict_reason: Literal any-registry duplicate stop: lattice overlap 99.8618% (and dense-prior support 100%). Prior focus-only approval was invalid; pre-placement surface audit not established.
limitations: All nine live scores are user-reported; no organizer receipt ties any score to exact bytes.
The projection extrapolates a 9-point regression below its fitted range and assumes the packing gain transfers to TP.
No design in this evidence reaches 0.32-0.44; the published family plateaus at 0.25-0.278.
